question: What selling price was Team IS1002 working with at first, what price range did they settle on later, and which speaker pushed hardest for a higher, more exclusive price?

steps.answer: Team IS1002 initially set a wholesale selling price of 25 Euros (IS1002b), then shifted upward, settling on a 35–50 Euro range in IS1002c once they committed to higher-end features (scroll wheel, cradle, locator). Speaker D (marketing) pushed hardest for an even higher, exclusive price, at one point proposing 89 Euros and later 50–60 Euros, calling it 'the Rolls Royce of remote controls.'
